summary: The Extensible Provisioning Protocol (EPP) can be extended, but it did not describe how extensions are managed. This informational document describes a procedure for registering and managing EPP extensions.

eli5.summary: EPP is used to manage things like domain names, and people add new features to it. This sets up a list so everyone can find and keep track of the add-ons.

questions: how to register an epp extension
